name: Mevabi – Auto Image Finder & Inserter
author: Mevabi

sections.description:
Mevabi – Auto Image Finder & Inserter helps WordPress users quickly find and insert high-quality images without leaving the editor. Search millions of royalty-free photos, stock images, illustrations and GIFs from popular image providers and add them directly to your posts, pages and custom post types.

Whether you are a blogger, content creator, news publisher, affiliate marketer, SEO specialist or website owner, Mevabi makes it easier to enrich your content with professional visuals in just a few clicks.

Instead of manually visiting multiple stock photo websites, downloading images and uploading them to WordPress, Mevabi allows you to perform the entire workflow directly from your dashboard.

Supported Image Providers

  • Unsplash
  • Pexels
  • Pixabay
  • Openverse
  • Giphy

These services provide access to millions of free and royalty-free images suitable for blogs, business websites, educational websites, magazines, portfolios and more.

Key Features

  • Search free stock photos directly from WordPress.
  • Search royalty-free images without leaving the editor.
  • Compatible with Gutenberg Block Editor.
  • Compatible with Classic Editor (TinyMCE).
  • Insert images directly into post content.
  • Set images as featured images in one click.
  • Automatic image search based on post title.
  • Configurable number of search results.
  • Attribution metadata stored automatically when available.
  • Fast image search interface.
  • Clean and lightweight admin experience.
  • Easy API configuration page.
  • Supports multiple image providers simultaneously.
  • Works with posts, pages and custom post types.
  • Helps content creators find relevant images faster.
  • Saves time when publishing articles and blog posts.

Perfect For

  • Bloggers
  • News websites
  • Magazine websites
  • Affiliate marketers
  • SEO professionals
  • Content creators
  • Business websites
  • Educational websites
  • WordPress agencies
  • Freelance web designers

Why Use Mevabi?

Visual content can improve user engagement, increase time on page and make articles more attractive to readers. Finding relevant images is often one of the most time-consuming parts of content publishing.

Mevabi streamlines this process by integrating image search directly into WordPress. With access to multiple providers from a single interface, you can quickly discover suitable images and publish content faster.

Gutenberg Integration

Mevabi includes a native Gutenberg block that allows users to search and insert images directly from the Block Editor. This creates a seamless workflow for modern WordPress websites.

Classic Editor Support

If your website still uses the Classic Editor, Mevabi integrates directly into TinyMCE, allowing you to search and insert images without changing your workflow.

SEO Benefits

Adding relevant images can help improve content quality and user experience. Mevabi helps publishers quickly locate appropriate visual assets for articles, tutorials, guides, reviews, news posts and informational content.

Supported Content Types

  • Blog posts
  • Pages
  • Landing pages
  • Product descriptions
  • Tutorials
  • News articles
  • Reviews
  • Educational content
  • Affiliate content
  • Custom post types

External Services

This plugin connects to external image provider APIs in order to search and retrieve royalty-free images, stock photos and GIFs selected by the user.

1. Pexels API

Used to search royalty-free images.

Data sent:

  • Search keywords entered by the user.

Terms of Service:
https://www.pexels.com/terms-of-service/

Privacy Policy:
https://www.pexels.com/privacy-policy/

2. Pixabay API

Used to search royalty-free images.

Data sent:

  • Search keywords entered by the user.

Terms of Service:
https://pixabay.com/service/terms/

Privacy Policy:
https://pixabay.com/service/privacy/

3. Openverse API

Used to search openly licensed images and media.

Data sent:

  • Search keywords entered by the user.

Terms:
https://wordpress.org/openverse/

Privacy Policy:
https://automattic.com/privacy/

4. Giphy API

Used to search GIF images.

Data sent:

  • Search keywords entered by the user.

Terms of Service:
https://support.giphy.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020027752-GIPHY-API-Terms-of-Service

Privacy Policy:
https://giphy.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mevabi folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Mevabi.
  4. Enter the API keys for the providers you want to use.
  5. Start searching and inserting images directly from the editor.
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys for all providers?

No. You can use only the providers you prefer. Openverse can be used without an API key, although rate limits may apply.

Which editors are supported?

Mevabi supports both the Gutenberg Block Editor and the Classic Editor.

Can I set a featured image?

Yes. Images can be inserted into content or set as the featured image with a single click.

Can I search images automatically?

Yes. Mevabi can automatically search using the current post title as the search query.

Where can I get API keys?

Unsplash:
https://unsplash.com/developers

Pexels:
https://www.pexels.com/api/

Pixabay:
https://pixabay.com/api/docs/

Openverse:
https://api.openverse.org/v1/

Giphy:
https://developers.giphy.com/

Does the plugin download images to my WordPress site?

Yes. Selected images are imported into your WordPress Media Library and can be used like any other media file.
